scope: Independent test authorship on frozen PR 501. Offline native synthetic assets, SQLite, standard threads and a local compatibility callback.

observations: The concurrent ordinary reader received LIBRARY_SEARCH_INDEX (database is locked) while the valid callback paused. The first and subsequent serial reads found the exact assets. Source, native library and derived index hash checks passed.

Six malformed decision mappings completed successfully. The missing field raised a raw KeyError. Three non-mappings raised raw TypeError. All ten cases failed the typed-refusal assertion; no source or index hash changed.
After Alpha lost eligibility, the accepted cursor returned Gamma and skipped Beta. A fresh first page returned Beta.
The genuine Boolean admission control selected only the exact Beta reference. Unchanged eligibility paginated Alpha, Beta and Gamma without omission.
